This dataset contains agent execution traces of Gemini 3 Flash running on the AppWorld benchmark, specifically evaluated on the test-normal dataset split. The traces capture the full span-level execution detail of the model interacting with AppWorld's simulated app ecosystem.

author: Trampoline-AI
description:
PredictRLM AppWorld run artifacts
	

This dataset repository stores an encrypted protected artifact bundle for the
PredictRLM/AppWorld runs.

	
		
	
	
		Files
	


runs.bundle — encrypted archive containing AppWorld run directories,
including task traces, proposer traces, candidate policies, evaluator outputs,
configs, and cost logs.

The bundle is encrypted to avoid publishing benchmark-derived raw traces and
task/evaluator-derived material in plain text.
